

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: setup

source(here::here("libraries.R"))

hhdr <- here::here("data-raw")
neon <- fs::path(hhdr, "neon")
judy <- fs::path(hhdr, "judy")
rds <- fs::path(hhdr, "rds")
work <- fs::path(hhdr, "work")

```

## Retrieve prepared data

```{r}
#| label: get-data

linkages <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "linkages.rds"))
accounts <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "accounts.rds"))
contacts <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "contacts.rds"))
donations <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "donations.rds"))
events <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "events.rds"))
evcat1 <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "events_no_majorcat.rds"))
registrations <- readRDS(fs::path(rds, "registrations.rds"))

xljudy <- read_excel(

```

## Construct minor category for events

```{r}
# 25th Annual Putnam County Spelling Bee - Nov 28 at 8pm
regorder <- c("performance", "class", "community", "other")

count(events, status)
count(events, )

events_data_erin <- events |>
  select(
    event_majorcat,
    event_category = category,
    event_name,
    event_start_date = starts_on,
    event_id,
    event_code = code
  ) |>
  mutate(event_majorcat = factor(event_majorcat, levels = regorder)) |>
  mutate(
    event_minorcat = case_when(
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_category, coll("Dance", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "dance",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, coll("Dance", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "dance",

      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_category, coll("Music", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, coll("Music from Salem", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, coll("Bob Warren", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, coll("Music", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Cabaret") ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Concert") ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, fixed("Blues")) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Red Guitar", ignore_case = TRUE)
        ) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Florian Kitt", ignore_case = TRUE)
        ) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Jean Redpath", ignore_case = TRUE)
        ) ~
        "music",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Village Harmony", ignore_case = TRUE)
        ) ~
        "music",

      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        event_category %in% c("Shakespeare", "Theater Performances") ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Putnam County Spelling Bee") ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Year of Magical Thinking", ignore_case = TRUE)
        ) ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Really Rosie", ignore_case = TRUE) # youth theater
        ) ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(
          event_name,
          coll("Sabina Spielrein", ignore_case = TRUE) # youth theater
        ) ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Crucible") ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Winter Carnival of New Work") ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Shakespeare") ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Travels With a Masked Man") ~
        "theater",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Theater") ~
        "theater",

      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        event_category == "Opera Performances" ~
        "opera",
      event_majorcat == "performance" &
        str_detect(event_name, "Opera") ~
        "opera",

      .default = "other"
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(event_majorcat, event_minorcat, event_category, event_id, event_name)

count(events_data_erin, event_majorcat, event_minorcat, event_category)

ns(events)
tmp <- events_data_erin |>
  filter(
    event_majorcat == "performance",
    event_minorcat == "other"
  )


```


```{r}

ns(registrations)
ns(events_data_erin)

registrations_erin <- registrations |>
  rename(event_status = status, event_name = event) |>
  left_join(
    events_data_erin |>
      select(event_id, event_name2 = event_name, event_minorcat),
    by = join_by(event_id)
  )
count(registrations_erin, event_name, event_name2) |>
  filter(event_name != event_name2)

registrations_erin |>
  select(event_majorcat, event_minorcat, event_id, event_name) |>
  distinct() |>
  count(event_majorcat, event_minorcat)

reg1_erin <- registrations_erin |>
  filter(!is.na(id)) |>
  filter(
    type %in% c("Registrant", "Registrant & Attendee"),
    event_status == "SUCCEEDED"
  ) |>
  summarise(
    amount = sum(amount),
    .by = c(id, name, group, event_majorcat, event_minorcat)
  )

tmp <- reg1_erin |>
  filter(!is.na(event_majorcat)) |>
  filter(!is.na(event_minorcat)) |>
  select(-group)
anyDuplicated(tmp)
anyDuplicated(tmp$id) # 10
anyDuplicated(tmp$name)

dups <- reg1_erin |>
  filter(!is.na(event_majorcat)) |>
  filter(!is.na(event_minorcat)) |>
  select(-group) |>
  arrange(id, name) |>
  mutate(n = n(), .by = c(id, name)) |>
  filter(n > 1)
dups

anyDuplicated(donor_events_erin)
anyDuplicated(donor_events_erin$name)
anyDuplicated(donor_events_erin$id)

donor_events_erin <- hhall_enhanced |>
  filter(!do_not_contact) |>
  select(id, name, group, donation_all) |>
  left_join(
    reg1_erin |>
      filter(!is.na(event_majorcat)) |>
      filter(!is.na(event_minorcat)) |>
      select(-group),
    by = join_by(id, name)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(event_majorcat)) |>
  mutate(event_majorcat = factor(event_majorcat, levels = regorder)) |>
  summarise(
    donation_all = first(donation_all),
    amount = sum(amount, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = c(id, name, event_majorcat, event_minorcat)
  ) |>
  arrange(event_majorcat, event_minorcat) |>
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = c(event_majorcat, event_minorcat),
    values_from = amount,
    values_fill = 0
  ) |>
  mutate(event_sum = rowSums(across(performance_dance:other_other))) |>
  relocate(event_sum, .after = donation_all) |>
  arrange(desc(donation_all)) |>
  filter(row_number() <= 100)

```

```{r}
#| label: events-majorcat

count(evcat1, category)
ns(evcat1)

# major category: performance, classes, ?
# minor category: music_mfs, music_other

# ---- Define pattern/category lists at the top ----

performance_names <- c(
  "2nd Annual Hubbard Hall-oween Celebration (2016)",
  "An Unforgettable Crooner Cabaret",
  "Hubbard Hall-oween Celebration",
  "Hubbard Hall-O-Ween Monster Mash Ball; 7pm",
  "Hubbard Halloween Ball - Saturday, October 26th, 2019 at 6pm",
  "Miscast Cabaret -- Fundraiser",
  "Music From Salem Listening Club: Music About Nature",
  "Night of Duets Cabaret -- Fundraiser",
  "Songs for Scholarships Cabaret - Saturday July 28th at 7pm",
  "Special Event: A Day at the Opera, August 15",
  "TriBeCaStan: In Concert!",
  "Whispering Bones"
)

performance_patterns <- c(
  "Brews & Blues",
  "Blues & Brews",
  "A Christmas Carol"
)

performance_cats <- c(
  "Music Performances",
  "Music from Salem Performances",
  "Opera Performances",
  "Shakespeare"
)

# "Exceptions to the performance categories that should be classes"
class_exceptions_performance <- c("Dance Mob")
class_exceptions_dance <- c(
  "Dance Ceili",
  "Dance Mob",
  "Dance Showcase",
  "Irish Ceili",
  "Russian Tea",
  "Young Dancer"
)
class_exceptions_theater <- c(
  "Drama Club",
  "Teen Theater",
  "Teen Theatre",
  "Youth Chorale",
  "Youth Theater",
  "Youth Theatre"
)

class_cats <- c(
  "Classes",
  "Ballet",
  "Bollywood & BollyX",
  "Dance Workshops",
  "Foil Fencing",
  "Hip Hop",
  "Irish Step Dance",
  "Pilates/Yoga",
  "Puppetry",
  "Tap Dance",
  "Visual Arts",
  "Visual Arts - Crafts",
  "Wellness",
  "Workshops"
)

community_cats <- c(
  "Community Events",
  "Curiosity Forum",
  "Dinners",
  "Exhibits, Films & Lectures",
  "Film Screenings",
  "Home & Garden",
  "Literary"
)
community_patterns <- c("Community", "Garden Tour", "Holiday Breakfast")

other_cats <- c("Auditions", "Fundraising Events", "Special Events")

# Patterns for NA category but class-like event names
class_patterns_na <- c("Drama Club", "Yoga")

# ---- Helper: collapse patterns for str_detect ----
pattern_collapse <- function(x) paste(x, collapse = "|")

matches_any_fixed <- function(strings, patterns) {
  vapply(strings, function(s) any(str_detect(s, fixed(patterns))), logical(1))
}


# ---- Main pipeline ----

evcat2 <- evcat1 |>
  mutate(
    event_majorcat = case_when(
      ## ------ PERFORMANCE ------
      event_name %in% performance_names ~ "performance",
      matches_any_fixed(event_name, performance_patterns) ~ "performance",
      # Performance categories minus exceptions:
      category == "Performances" &
        !str_detect(
          event_name,
          pattern_collapse(class_exceptions_performance)
        ) ~
        "performance",
      category == "Dance Performances" &
        !str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(class_exceptions_dance)) ~
        "performance",
      category == "Theater Performances" &
        !str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(class_exceptions_theater)) ~
        "performance",
      category %in% performance_cats ~ "performance",

      ## ------ CLASSES ------
      # Class exceptions inside performance categories:
      category == "Performances" &
        str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(class_exceptions_performance)) ~
        "class",
      category == "Dance Performances" &
        str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(class_exceptions_dance)) ~
        "class",
      category == "Theater Performances" &
        str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(class_exceptions_theater)) ~
        "class",
      # Categories and partials
      category %in% class_cats ~ "class",
      str_detect(category, "Classes|Martial Arts|Workshops") ~ "class",
      category == "Children's Theater" ~ "class",
      category == "Chorale" ~ "class", # review later if needed

      # Classes - NA category but matching key patterns
      (is.na(category) &
        str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(class_patterns_na))) ~
        "class",
      (is.na(category) &
        str_detect(event_name, "Teen") &
        str_detect(event_name, "Showcase")) ~
        "class",

      ## ------ COMMUNITY ------
      category %in% community_cats ~ "community",
      str_detect(event_name, pattern_collapse(community_patterns)) ~
        "community",

      ## ------ OTHER ------
      category %in% other_cats | is.na(category) ~ "other",
      str_detect(event_name, "Gala") ~ "other",

      ## ------ CATCH-ALL ------
      TRUE ~ "ERROR"
    )
  ) |>
  select(event_majorcat, category, event_name, code, event_id, everything()) |>
  arrange(event_majorcat, category, event_name, starts_on)

count(evcat2, event_majorcat)
tmp <- count(evcat2, event_majorcat, category, event_name)

saveRDS(evcat2, fs::path(rds, "events_erin.rds"))

```
